elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no commercial general liability insurance requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no commercial general liability insurance requirement or aggregate limit.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires professional liability insurance of only USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires only USD 2,000,000. The operative language does not demonstrably establish that Garman does not process Customer Data, so the conditional requirement cannot be treated as inapplicable.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: No workers' compensation insurance covenant appears in the rendered clause.

elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no obligation to provide insurance certificates.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause states that Garman shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000.

result.reason: The operative addition exactly supplies the two fallback coverages and limits, but omits every other preferred coverage or administrative requirement and uses lower E&O and cyber limits than preferred. Although no unrelated obligation was added and the existing terms remain effective, the rendered version unnecessarily reorders the existing paragraphs, so it is not strictly minimal.
